name: OpenShell Bridge
description: Zero-leak autonomous coding in Orca powered by NVIDIA OpenShell. Confines Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Antigravity inside isolated Linux sandboxes (Landlock filesystem locks, deny-by-default L7 network egress, and proxy-injected credentials) so nothing from your host machine leaks—whether OpenShell provisions sandboxes locally via Docker or remotely on Kubernetes/K3s.

cover.alt: OpenShell Bridge for Orca connecting a zero-leak Orca host through NVIDIA OpenShell to sandboxed agents on Docker or K3s

screenshots.alt: Zero-leak isolation diagram: host files and secrets protected behind OpenShell Landlock, L7 egress proxy, and credential injection gates
screenshots.caption: Zero-leak boundary: host secrets stay outside the sandbox on both Docker and K3s
